Field Study · Downtown Los Angeles实地考察 · 洛杉矶市中心

Spanish Colonial Revival 西班牙殖民复兴风格

A visual & material analysis for the Santa Barbara–style renovation at Lushan International, Chengdu. 为成都麓山国际「圣塔芭芭拉」风格改造所做的视觉与材质分析。

The Spanish Colonial Revival reached its American peak in Southern California between roughly 1915 and the 1930s — and downtown Los Angeles remains one of its finest open-air galleries. The field photographs below read the style across four lenses: architecture, landscape, material & texture, and color — each translated into a practical renovation vocabulary. 西班牙殖民复兴约在 1915—1930 年代于南加州达到鼎盛，洛杉矶市中心至今仍是其最精彩的「露天美术馆」之一。以下实地照片从建筑、景观、材质与纹理、色彩四个维度解读这一风格，并将其转化为可落地的改造词汇。

Los Angeles Santa Barbara Chengdu · Lushan Renovation
01

Architectural Design建筑设计

Massing & Roof体量与屋顶

Low, horizontal, asymmetrical volumes with thick plastered-masonry walls; flat or low-pitched roofs capped in red clay barrel tile with exposed rafter tails.低矮、横向、非对称的体量，配以厚重的粉刷砌体承重墙；平屋顶或缓坡屋顶，覆红色陶土筒瓦，外露椽尾。

The Arch拱券

Semicircular arches unify entries, arcades and loggias — often paired or grouped into rhythmic sequences.半圆拱统一门廊、柱廊与凉廊，常成对或成组形成韵律。

Openings门窗洞口

Deeply recessed windows and doors, frequently framed in carved wood or sheltered by wrought-iron balconies and grilles.门窗深深内凹，常见雕木边框，或以锻铁阳台与格栅庇护。

Vertical Accents竖向点缀

Bell gables, towers and chimney masses punctuate an otherwise calm, earthbound silhouette.钟形山墙、塔楼与烟囱体量打破原本沉静、贴地的轮廓。

Ornament Concentration装饰聚焦

Decoration is restrained overall but concentrated at entries, cornices and windows — carved stone, painted tile and hand-forged iron.整体克制，装饰集中于入口、檐口与窗洞——雕石、彩绘瓷砖与手工锻铁。

02

Landscaping园林景观

Courtyard as Room庭院即房间

The patio / courtyard is an outdoor living room; the plan arranges rooms around it rather than decorating a leftover space.内院/天井是「户外起居室」，平面围绕其展开，而非事后点缀的空地。

Water水景

Fountains, reflecting pools and tiled basins cool the court and anchor it as the heart of the house.喷泉、倒影池与贴砖水池为庭院降温，并使其成为住宅的核心焦点。

Planting种植

Drought-tolerant Mediterranean species — olive, Italian cypress, citrus, bougainvillea, lavender, rosemary, agave and succulents.耐旱地中海植物——油橄榄、意大利柏、柑橘、三角梅、薰衣草、迷迭香、龙舌兰与多肉。

Hardscape硬质景观

Terracotta pavers, decomposed granite and saltillo tile define paths and terraces; low plastered walls with tile insets enclose them.陶土铺地、风化花岗岩与萨尔蒂约瓷砖界定路径与露台；低矮粉刷墙配瓷砖镶嵌围合。

Layering & Threshold层次与过渡

Deep eaves, arcades and pergolas create shaded thresholds that ease the transition from street to interior.深挑檐、柱廊与花架营造遮阴过渡，让从街道到室内的转换自然舒缓。

03

Materials, Stone & Texture材质、石材与纹理

Stucco灰泥 Stucco

Lime- or cement-based plaster, smooth-troweled or lightly textured, is the unifying skin of the whole composition.石灰/水泥基抹灰，光面或轻微质感，是统一整体的「皮肤」。

Terracotta & Glazed Tile陶土与釉面瓷砖

Barrel tiles, stair risers and azulejo tile bands add color, craft and hand-made warmth.筒瓦、楼梯踏步立板与 azulejo 瓷砖带增添色彩、工艺与手工温度。

Wrought Iron锻铁

Gates, grilles, railings and lanterns — thin, hand-forged, usually black — screen and embellish openings.大门、格栅、栏杆与灯具——纤细、手工锻造、多为黑色——既遮蔽又装饰洞口。

Timber木作

Carved beams, heavy doors, corbels and lintels in dark, oiled wood bring depth against pale stucco.雕梁、厚重木门、托梁与过梁采用深色油木，与浅色灰泥形成层次。

Stone & Granite石材与花岗岩

Natural stone and granite accents ground the composition at bases, fountains, steps and paving — lending weight, durability and tactile grain.天然石材与花岗岩点缀用于勒脚、喷泉、台阶与铺地，赋予稳重、耐久与可触摸的纹理质感。

04

Color Palette色彩搭配

Warm, sun-baked and low-contrast — anchored by stucco cream and terracotta, lifted by small saturated accents.温暖、久经日晒、低对比——以灰泥米色与陶土色为基调，点缀少量饱和色提亮。

05

Application Notes · Lushan改造要点 · 麓山

  • Carry the low, horizontal, stucco-clad massing and clay-tile roof line as the primary gesture.以低矮、横向、灰泥覆盖的体量与陶土瓦屋脊线作为首要手法。
  • Keep an ornament budget: spend it at the entry, on a single arcade, and on tile accents.克制装饰预算：用在入口、单段柱廊与瓷砖点缀上。
  • Repeat one accent tile color (azulejo blue or sage) to tie landscape, tile and trim together.反复使用一种点缀瓷砖色（阿苏莱霍蓝或鼠尾草绿），串联景观、瓷砖与饰边。
  • Ground the house with stone at bases, thresholds, and a courtyard fountain.用石材在勒脚、门槛与庭院喷泉处「压住」建筑，赋予根基感。

    1. David Gebhard, Casa California: Spanish-Style Houses from Santa Barbara to San Clemente — a photographic survey of Southern California Spanish Revival residential work.南加州西班牙复兴住宅的影像总览。
    2. Kathryn Masson & Paul Rocheleau, Santa Barbara Style — on the region that gave the style its residential, sun-baked character.关于赋予这一风格住宅化、久经日晒气质的地区。
